details.effect: On Evolve: Search your deck for up to 2 Officer followers, reveal them, and add them to your hand.

issues: On Evolve is encoded incorrectly as searchDeckChoose with "lookAt": 5 and a single optional pick; it should search the full deck for up to 2 Officer followers, reveal them, and add them to your hand, e.g. encode a deck tutor/search that can select up to 2 matching cards rather than looking at only the top 5.

details.effect: [fanfare] Put a Naterran Great Tree token into your EX area. While this card is on your field, any Naterran Great Tree you play costs 1 less.

issues: The passive cost reduction is too broad: playCostReduction on this card makes the source cheaper, but the text says any "Naterran Great Tree" you play costs 1 less while this is on your field. It should be encoded as a passive aura/effect that reduces the play cost of Naterran Great Tree cards you play, not this card itself.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: This card costs 5 less to play for every 5 Natura cards in your cemetery. ---------- [fanfare] Select an enemy follower on the field and destroy it.

issues: The passive playCostReduction amount is incorrect: the text says this card costs 5 less to play for every 5 Natura cards in your cemetery, but the current cemeteryFilterCount/divisor 5 only yields 1 reduction per 5 cards. It should multiply that count by 5, e.g. a dynamic amount equal to 5 × floor(Natura cards in your cemetery / 5).
